events.title: Japanese Antique Fair @IPPIN Project
events.description:
Discover authentic Japanese antiques and one-of-a-kind treasures, handpicked and brought directly from Japan.
Browse a carefully curated collection of timeless pieces, including classic ceramics, handcrafted bamboo baskets, vintage home décor, and unique collectibles. Many of our bamboo baskets were discovered in traditional Japanese homes and date back to the early 20th century, each carrying its own history and craftsmanship.
Alongside our antiques, you’ll find contemporary handmade works by artisans in Japan, including aizome (indigo-dyed) and sashiko textiles, tea leaf–dyed and kakishibu (persimmon tannin)–dyed placemats, handcrafted ceramics, and DAIDAI’s Kurumi Ware—beautiful glassware made with walnut ash, giving each piece its signature soft green hue. A customer favorite from last year, Kurumi Ware is back by popular demand.
Whether you’re a collector or simply appreciate Japanese craftsmanship, you’ll discover timeless pieces that blend tradition, artistry, and everyday beauty.

events.title: A Summer Afternoon with Peak
events.description:
Click here for tickets: https://wl.eventim.us/event/a-summer-afternoon-with-peak/698743?afflky=Getitrightthefirsttime
Industry City and Get It Right Music in association with Murmrr Presents are thrilled to present A Summer afternoon with Peak!
Event Info
Date: August 8th, 2026
Doors: 4:00pm
Show: 4:30-8:00pm
Tickets: $15 per person plus fees in advance/$20 per person day of show
Address: Industry City Bandshell Stage, Courtyard 1/2 at Industry City in Brooklyn New York between 36th and 37th street and 2nd and 3rd Avenues.
ENTER 238 36th Street, Brooklyn, NY on your GPS device
The venue is located in an open-air courtyard featuring a full concert sound stage. Fans can get affordable drinks from the venue’s bar and order food from over 17 options inside the adjoining food hall. Concert is rain or shine.
How to get here:
Take the D, N, R lines to 36th street station in Brooklyn and walk west one block to Industry City. 3 stops from Manhattan. 30 minutes from Herald Square.
From Long Island, take the LIRR to Atlantic Terminal then take the D, N or R train to 36th street.
More about Peak
PEAK is a Brooklyn-based Quartet led by guitarist Jeremy Hilliard, a versatile singer–songwriter, that has been performing in its current incarnation since 2019.PEAK’s original music, characterized as psychedelic indie funk, draws from influences ranging from Talking Heads, Phish, and the Grateful Dead to Tom Petty and Bright Eyes.
The band’s three albums, “Electric Bouquet,” “Choppy Water,” and “Vanishing Skies” highlight PEAK’s versatile talents within a range that veers from guitar-driven rock to Americana and melodic indie tunes.
Hilliard’s musicianship and lyric narrative style mesh seamlessly with the talents of keyboard master Johnny Young. Friends for many years, the two started writing songs together as the band began to take shape. Blind since age 17, Young has been blessed with a soulful voice and musical talents that help PEAK paint richly detailed, ever-changing visions of color and sound on the stage.
Drummer Kito Bovenschulte and bassist Josh T. Carter provide the flawless beat that moves the music of PEAK through a playlist including a distinctive mix of searing blues rock, high-energy electro funk and moody indie originals.
The band has shared the stage with acts such as Goose, Eggy, Dizgo, Lespecial, Neighbor, Mihali, Kendal Street Company, The Magic Beans, Space Bacon, and many more.

events.title: Sake and Cheese Pairing Class and Brewery Tour
events.description:
Step away from that bottle of vino and join us to sample the absolute best beverage to pair with cheese – We are talking about sake! If you haven’t yet tried pairing craft sake and premium cheese, you are in for a revelation. We’ll explore a wide range of flavors and textures… and together, we’ll discover the most exciting combinations of sake styles and cheeses from around the world. The experience is fun, interactive and absolutely delicious! Join us at Brooklyn Kura to learn about sake where sake is made!
What’s included:
A welcome sake to get you started!
A brief intro to sake and cheese basics.
Guided Tasting of 5 Japanese craft sakes from different regions paired to perfection with 5 outstanding cheese varieties.
Exploration of sake and cheese production styles and terrior.
Enjoy some nibbles and spreads on your cheese board that will take the pairing over the top.
Handouts so you can bring your newfound sake and cheese knowledge home
Finish with a Guided tour through our new Sake Brewery

events.title: Industry City Gourmet Food and Drinks Tour
events.description:
Set against the iconic backdrop of Sunset Park’s historic waterfront, the massive, revitalized structures of Industry City form a breathtaking stage for an exclusive culinary journey. This premium food and cocktail tour is a curated exploration of taste and craft, transforming an evening into a memorable, high-end experience.
Your adventure begins with artistic bonbons at Lilac Chocolates, explores gourmet imports at Sahadi’s, and includes a refined whiskey tasting at Fort Hamilton Distillery, followed by a sophisticated sake flight. Savor additional artisanal discoveries within the awe-inspiring industrial halls.
Perfect as a distinctive date night, this tour is also fully customizable for private groups and corporate retreats. We specialize in tailoring this engaging experience for team-building and client entertainment, making it an ideal one-day corporate outing. A sophisticated mini-vacation for locals and a profound discovery for visitors.

events.description:
Staten Island’s favorite pop-up market is coming to Brooklyn!
Join Faire & Flourish at Carreau Club in Industry City for an afternoon of shopping small. We’re bringing together a unique mix of 20+ local makers and small businesses offering everything from handmade goods, apparel and accessories to treats, gifts, home décor, and more.
Take on the Faire & Flourish Quest!
We’re introducing the Faire & Flourish Quest – a fun new way to explore the market while supporting local businesses. Complete simple market challenges for a chance to win prizes from our participating vendors.
Every market will feature a brand-new Quest, with the challenges revealed on our Instagram leading up to the event. Be sure to follow @faireandflourish so you don’t miss out!
Come shop, discover new small businesses, and spend the afternoon exploring Carreau Club and everything Industry City has to offer.
RSVP on Eventbrite to attend for free!
